literalDefinitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.comparatorRegret

boundary.reason: Complete unchanged literal signed fixed-comparator regret definition, bound to the independently sealed context. Shows both finite loss sums and their subtraction, with no adjacent declaration.

literalDefinitions.entireLiteralText:
noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (prediction t)) - ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t u

literalDefinitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.empiricalMean

boundary.reason: Complete unchanged literal finite-prefix arithmetic mean. The empty-prefix value is zero by total real division; uniqueness of the empirical minimizer requires positive prefix length.

literalDefinitions.entireLiteralText:
noncomputable def empiricalMean (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, y t) / n

literalDefinitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict

boundary.reason: Complete unchanged literal strict-past learner with prescribed initial one half. No population mean, horizon, IID or convergence input is supplied to this definition.

literalDefinitions.entireLiteralText:
noncomputable def meanPredict (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 1/2 else empiricalMean y t

literalDefinitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlPredict

boundary.reason: Complete literal arbitrary-initial FTL definition from the independently sealed six-context packet; positive-time strict-prefix mean and initial branch included. No source edit.

literalDefinitions.entireLiteralText:
noncomputable def ftlPredict (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then initial else empiricalMean y t

literalDefinitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.squaredBestRegret

boundary.reason: Complete unchanged original signed pathwise loss-minus-sInf definition. Actual interval-minimum attainment is proved separately under the stated target-prefix assumption.

literalDefinitions.entireLiteralText:
noncomputable def squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t - y t)^2) -
    sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
